title: Long War Index factions file (factions/index.json)
description: One record per faction: its book and the data file of each kind of data. Each kind of data is a property: weapons, wargear, special_rules. A later kind (units) adds a property like these. The property core gives the files that belong to no faction.

data_version.description: Hash of the file content. It changes when any faction file changes.

core.description: The files that belong to no faction.

all_factions.description: The closed list of the factions: the factions of §1.4.1 and the other exported factions. A faction that is in neither list is a data error. names includes the factions that have no export yet.

url.description: The page of §1.4.1 on the site.

names.description: The faction names as §1.4.1 prints them.

other_names.description: The exported factions with no parent faction that §1.4.1 does not list (for example "Harlequins"), as their faction_name. Not present if there are none. A supplement (a faction with a parent faction) is never in this list.

parent_faction.description: Key of the faction whose codex a supplement needs: blood_angels -> space_marines.

version.description: Edition of the book, for example "5.0".

printing.description: Date of a revised printing of that edition (YYYY-MM-DD).

units.description: The datasheets of the faction, without the options: units/<faction>.json.

book_options.description: The book-wide option lists of the faction: book_options/<faction>.json.

army_construction.description: The army construction rules of the faction: army_construction/<faction>.json. count: the allegiances and the Rites of War.

file.description: Path on the site, for example /data/v5/weapons/tyranids.json.

count.description: Number of entries in that file.
